d: The saga that began with threats against Salman Khan has now escalated to an attack on Tiger Shroff. Along the way, there have also been incidents involving Baba Siddique and Rohit Shetty. Those who claim responsibility for these attacks identify themselves as members of the Lawrence Bishnoi group, issuing threats that Bollywood will face dire consequences if it does not toe the line set by Bishnoi.
